name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Client Success & Operations | Onboarding Coordination & Proactive Client Communication

Coordinated 25+ client onboardings a month at Wix, retained all but one of 15-20 partners at Birdeye, and now runs every client engagement at Solenzo, a digital marketing practice, tracking timelines, deliverables, and next steps so nothing falls through the cracks.

Built automated appointment confirmations, reminders, and follow-up sequences so clients always know what happens next.

experience.title: Account Executive / Client Strategist
bullets: Coordinated execution across internal departments for multi-stakeholder digital marketing accounts, resolving client feedback promptly to protect satisfaction and retention.

bullets: Ran client accounts end to end at a performance marketing agency, managing workflows and tasks in ClickUp and building processes that reduced handoff errors between sales and delivery.
